title: ServiceLog Service Metadata
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for CSP-owned service metadata YAML documents. Each document describes exactly one cloud service offering, in a Backstage-compatible Resource envelope. The platform (ServiceLog) owns this schema and its controlled vocabularies; CSP teams own the values inside it for the services they maintain.

apiVersion.description: Backstage-compatible envelope version. Fixed so documents remain ingestible by a future Backstage Catalog without a rewrite.

kind.description: Backstage entity kind. Every ServiceLog service-offering document is a Resource.

name.description: Stable machine-readable identifier for the service. Must be unique across the entire loaded catalog (enforced across documents, not just within one file). Becomes Service.id.

type.description: Backstage Resource subtype. Fixed for every ServiceLog document.

owner.description: Backstage Catalog ownership / group reference (e.g. group:default/example-team). This is Backstage entity ownership, NOT the ServiceLog-facing Service Owner -- it must never be normalized into Service.serviceOwner. Optional and intentionally omitted in prototype data where no real owning group is known; do not populate with an invented value.

lifecycle.description: Backstage lifecycle metadata (e.g. production, experimental). Not a ServiceLog UI field. Optional.

profile.description: ServiceLog-facing metadata. Normalizes 1:1 into the Service model consumed by the UI.

cloudProvider.description: Owning CSP. Controlled vocabulary -- adding a new provider requires a schema change, not a new YAML value.

serviceCategory.description: Controlled vocabulary for grouping in the ServiceLog UI. Centrally governed so spelling variants (e.g. 'AI & Machine Learning' vs 'AI and Machine Learning') never silently create duplicate categories.

serviceDescription.description: Long-form description shown in the card and detail panel.

serviceInternalDoc.description: Internal documentation link. May be a full URL or a path relative to the internal docs portal, matching how CSP source metadata records it.

cloudAto.description: Cloud ATO(s) covering this service. Controlled vocabulary array (future multi-select); current prototype data carries exactly one value per service.

serviceOwner.description: ServiceLog-facing accountable person for this service. A person, not a team/group. Distinct from spec.owner (Backstage Catalog ownership).

serviceLimitations.description: Optional caveat surfaced as a warning in the detail panel.

fedRampStatus.description: Controlled vocabulary for FedRAMP authorization status.

trmStatus.description: Controlled vocabulary for Technical Reference Model status. Exactly these four values -- an unrecognized value (e.g. a typo, or an invented status) must fail validation rather than being coerced into one of these.

trmRestrictionOwner.description: Jira/Outlook-style group responsible for a Restricted service. A group, not a person. Required when trmStatus is Restricted; must not be set otherwise the field is left absent.

trmLink.description: Link into the authoritative TRM reference for this service.

fundingApproach.description: Controlled vocabulary for how provisioning is funded.

approvalWorkflow.description: Controlled vocabulary for the approval path required to provision this service.

provisioningSLA.description: Human-readable turnaround time for provisioning (e.g. 'Same day', '5 business days').

serviceUseCases.description: Common use cases shown in the detail panel.

serviceOnboardingRequirements.description: Onboarding/intake fields required to request this service, as clean strings -- never legacy HTML or hover-tooltip markup.
